evals.name: Deterministic 15-Step Middleware Ordering & Error Handler Positioning
evals.prompt: Inspect an Express server pipeline where the global error handler is mounted before the router and body compression is placed after body parsing, and refactor it into standard sequential order.
evals.expected_output: Reorders middlewares to mount Correlation ID, Real IP, Logger, Security Headers, CORS, Compression, Body Parser, Routes, and places the Error Handler as the final terminal middleware.
assertions: Ensures global RFC-7807 error handler is mounted as the terminal (final) middleware
Positions compression middleware before body parser to avoid parse corruption
Injects correlation ID and real IP resolver before logging and security checks
Mounts versioned API router under '/api/v1' prefix

evals.name: Server Timeout & Keep-Alive Hardening for Cloud Load Balancers
evals.prompt: Configure an HTTP server instance deployed behind an AWS Application Load Balancer (60s idle timeout) to prevent 502 connection dropouts and Slowloris attacks.
evals.expected_output: Configures keepAliveTimeout to 65s, headersTimeout to 66s, and requestTimeout to 30s.
assertions: Sets keepAliveTimeout to at least 65000ms to exceed ALB 60s idle timeout
Enforces request read timeout of 30s to mitigate Slowloris resource exhaustion
Eliminates race condition where Node.js closes TCP connections during ALB transit

evals.name: Reverse Proxy Real IP Extraction & Rate Limiter Shielding
evals.prompt: Configure a rate limiter middleware for a service behind Cloudflare and an Nginx reverse proxy so rate limiting does not throttle the proxy internal IP.
evals.expected_output: Enables proxy trust and extracts true client IP using CF-Connecting-IP and X-Forwarded-For before executing the rate limiter.
assertions: Enables proxy trust configuration (e.g. 'trust proxy: true')
Resolves client IP from verified upstream headers ('CF-Connecting-IP', 'X-Forwarded-For')
Prevents applying rate-limiting buckets to reverse proxy gateway IP addresses
Ensures legitimate users behind shared proxies maintain independent rate quotas
